Name: Candace
Dialog: (in her bedroom; on video phone) I'm totally sunk, Stace! I've been working on Jeremy's birthday present for months, but it's not even close to being as good as I want it to be. (Cut to reveal she's working on a popup book showing their first kiss.) Ugh! Lame!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (in a store, purchasing many hair bows) Oh, come on, Candace. You're overthinking this. (The cashier puts a watermelon on the tread.) Jeremy'll love anything you make. What's your worry?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I just wanna do something really special to show Jeremy how much I care. Something way over the top! Something that defies the laws of physics and exceeds the boundaries of the imagination — (realizes what she's talking about) Oh no.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, yes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No no no no no! Anything but that!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You're going to have to ask for help from...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb. (Puts her head in her hand like she has a migraine.) Uggggh.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, now that we've ironed out the bugs in our fusion-powered popper, the popcorn is nice and fluffy...and no longer glowing, so we're good to go. (Candace comes in mumbling under her breath.) Uh, what's that, Candace?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Lemme talk to her, guys. I speak sullen. (He and Candace have a conversation in mumbled gibberish.) Candace messed up and now Jeremy's birthday is ruined.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey!! You completely misinterpreted what I said!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Nuance.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So what's goin' on, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sighs) It's Jeremy's birthday and I wanna do something really special to show I care and you guys are good at doing, you know, what you do, and, well, all I have is this scrapbook and I don't wanna blow it so can you help me, huh? (gives Phineas the book)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow! This is great! It's like a blueprint! Ferb, I know what else we're gonna do today!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Great! Start workin' your magic and, no pressure, but it's gotta be PERFECT!!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We'll do our best!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (mumbling) Thnk yu.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh. She said, "Where's Perry?"

Name: Candace
Dialog: You have got to work on your sullen!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hey, there, Agent P! Well, it's Horrific Movie Night at my house where a bunch of Agency guys get together and make fun of ridiculously bad movies.

Name: Carl
Dialog: He's always the guy shushing everybody.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, there's a time for fun and a time to pay attention.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Pfft.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Anyway, Agent P, when we went to rent tonight's horrific horror classic, Night of the Living Torso, it was already gone. In fact, all the movies within the horror genre throughout Danville have been checked out, which is definitely a bummer, and could possibly be evil. Go check on Doof and see if he's bogarting those movies...uh, before 6

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, I'm headed out.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (trying to not sound suspicious) Okay, Mom.

Name: Linda
Dialog: What's with the box?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, uh, nothing. I just wanted to see what this stuff looked like outside.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, is this a ploy to get me to go outside to see what the boys are up to?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No!! Er, I mean, no need. (pushing her mom out) Just go and, uh feel free to stay out for a while. Stay out all afternoon in fact. Heh-heh, heh.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Reverse psychology. Nice try, hon. Glad to see you changing it up. See ya later.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, bye.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (cntd.) (approaches her brothers with the box at the backyard.) So here's all the Jeremobilia I could find. (gives the box to Phineas) Now what?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool! (Ferb gives Candace a camera) Now just go around town and take pictures of all the Jeremy-related places and things you can. The camera will transmit them back to us to incorporate into our mega-interactive scrapbook-aganza.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No problem-o! Candace is on field duty, peace!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Isabella approaches to him.) I'm sorry, were you gonna say something? (Isabella shrugs.) Okay.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sighs, pauses the movie) Isn't that always the way? Right at the exciting part, that's when the doorbell rings...or, y'know, a platypus breaks it down. Anyway, behold the Worst-Fear-inator! (pause) What? (Doof tilts his head. POV shot from Doof as he sees the popcorn cart is blocking the inator.) Oh, yeah, I-I guess from your point of view, it's a little difficult to see. Lemme just get this outta the way for you. (He pushes the popcorn out out of the way.) There we go. Now, in my never-ending pursuit of domination, I discovered that the best evil rulers used fear to keep people in line. So to get into the right headspace, I did what any logical evil scientist would do

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (cntd.) (voiceover) Once I was terrified, I was able to analyze the fear-based synapses of the brain and extrapolate some wonderful data!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (cntd.) Basically, I shoot someone with the machine, and whatever they are afraid of actually appears...in real life! Whaddya say, Perry the Platypus? Ya like being a guinea pig? Actually, you'd look kinda cute as a guinea pig. I mean, I wonder if you'd be teal. I bet you would. I bet you'd be a cute little teal guinea pig. Something to think about for the future. Anyway, Perry the Platypus, let's fire this baby up and see what scares you. (He presses the button activating the inator.) 'Cause, y'know, it's gonna materialize right over there. (A green beam hits Perry.) Alright, so what are you afraid of, where is it? (looks around) What the hey? Nothing? (A business card slips through the ropes. Doof takes the card and reads it.) "Perry the Platypus

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ooh, score! That awning is the same color as Jeremy's eyes! (snaps the photo) Aaaand... daffodils! Just like the ones he gave me on our third date! (Snaps the flower.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Incoming. Perfect! Same color as Jeremy's eyes! Huh, flower. I'm drawin' a blank.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Daffodil, third date.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Riiiight... Now the machine will take the images, and print them into giant scaled-up form. (A printer prints out a flat daffodil, which folds itself into an oragami daffodil, and emits a scent.)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Nice touch! Smells like my grandma!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I thought your grandma smelled like ant pheromones.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Naw, that's the other one.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: These should really make Jeremy's Birthday Scrapbook-aganza a full sensory experience!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (sarcastically) Great, just what I always wanted

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, what else? Ah! (She walks up to a couple drinking outside a French café. She takes the man's mug.) 'Scuse. Hot cocoa! (Snaps the mug and sips.) Not bad, although Jeremy prefers it with a little more cinnamon. (Walks away.) I gotta make a note of that for the boys.

Name: Man
Dialog: I guess my fortune came true. "You will share your cocoa with a long-necked teenager." See? Right there.

Name: Woman
Dialog: Mine just says, "Your boyfriend's gonna get a fortune cookie at a French café."

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Get ready, Perry the Platypus! The Tri-State Area's about to confront its fears! (Evil laughter from Doof. Another business card with mechanical arms and legs slips through the rope and crawls up to Perry's tail. A laser beam shoots through the robot and burns the rope down, freeing Perry. He kicks Doof.) Aaah! Ow ow! I landed on my jawbone, right on that weird...sticky-outy part under your ear! I-And my jawbone landed on the remote. Ah, Doof. (The inator activates and shoots Doof.) Okay, nothing bad will happen as long as I don't think about anything scary or... (A pounding on the door is heard.) Oh no! I couldn't help it, it just popped in there. It can't be! (The door breaks down revealing evil vending machine robots.) Vending machines are taking over! I said it could happen! No! Stay back! Stay back! Back! Flee! Flee! (Doof attempts to escape, but the vending machines grab hold of him.) No no no! I'm not really hungry! Really! (Stutters) No no, not the tiny vanilla cookies. How long have those been in there?! (The machines force feed Doof a packet of vanilla cookies.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Candace, the scrapbook-aganza is complete! Plus, we got Love Händel to come in for a live soundtrack! (Whip pan right to reveal the band.)

Name: Danny
Dialog: Okay, guys, performance level! (Strums the intro)

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm gonna need a test run so I can make notes.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure. You're the boss.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's right. (She walks up to the gondola, which activates.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That sounded great guys, but it's a B-natural in the chorus!

Name: Danny
Dialog: Told 'ya!

Name: Bobbi
Dialog: That's what I was playing!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) No! No! Not that! Anything but the fake red licorice! It tastes like... (Doof grunts. Perry stops walking and figures he has to save Doof.) No! What possessed me to make such a horrifying inator?! (Perry jumps on the DVDs and hops onto the inator aiming it. He lands on the floor and hits the remote. The inator hits the vending machines. A giant nickel rolls by and the machines run for their lives.) Well, I guess now we know what scares vending machines.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, Candace, do you think Jeremy will like it?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (seriously) Yeah, I just have a few notes here. (Excitedly, as she reveals she drew a smiley face on the clipboard.) It's perfect! (gasps) I love it, guys! Iloveitiloveitiloveitiloveitiloveitiloveitiloveitiloveitiloveit...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (to Ferb) She had me at "smiley face".

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, you're back! (walking up to the inator) I am never setting that puppy off again! (He presses a button, and, as usual, the inator activates and aims across town.) Oops.

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's really perfect! (The beam hits Candace.) I'm glad Mom's gone for the day 'cause my biggest fear is that this is just gonna fly away before Jeremy gets here. (car horn honks, Candace gasps) And there he is! (runs off) Woohoo!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Uh, did anyone else see that weird green beam?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I wasn't gonna mention it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy!! Jeremy Jeremy Jeremy Jeremy Jeremy!!! You gotta see what the boys built in the backyard!!! (drags him)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (runs up) No no! No no!! It's gone! My worst fear has come true! I totally blew it!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Let me guess, you had your brothers build me something super cool for my birthday and now it disappeared. It's okay, I get it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We don't have the invention anymore, but here's what we used as a blueprint. Candace designed it herself. He gives Jeremy the scrapbook, which he opens on the page showing their first kiss.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oops. I really meant to hit the self-destruct button. I-I-I'll just get this for you. (Kaboom!) So, uh, you need your parking validated or, uh... Oh, oh, you found a spot on the street! Huh! Lucky you! Curse you, Perry the Platypus and all that. You know.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isabella, you've been awfully quiet all day.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (looks at her watch) I have just earned my 24 Hours of Silence Patch! I can see why you don't talk much, Ferb. I actually quite enjoyed it. I ended up having an inner dialogue with myself all day.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Welcome to Ferbland. (Zoom in on Ferb's brain.)

Name: Ferb head #1
Dialog: Yes, the universe is constantly expanding.

Name: Ferb head #2
Dialog: Then what is it expanding into?

Name: Ferb heads
Dialog: Ooooooh...

Name: Ferb head #3
Dialog: Okay, now my mind is blown.
